_notes: Fixed client-feedback fixture. The 9xxx code block was free on dev (su) 2026-10-30; avoid 9501 and 9911-9915 (soft-deleted, they reserve their codes in the recycle bin).
Names start with 'CF ' on purpose: cleanupTargets.PROTECTED_NAME_PATTERNS guards /^CF / so the residue sweep and fixture reconcile can never reclaim them. Never deleted.

Built on screen by src/utils/client-feedback/clientFeedbackFlow.ts through ensureOnScreen (existence is a GET, create/repair is UI). The Time job carries hourlyRate 1: a rate-less job raises 'No hourly rate available' on transfer.
Isolation unit is (crew, day): each scenario file owns one (fixtureCrew, dayOffset) pair, enforced by scenarioLoader.assertDistinctCrewDays.
CF JOB carries the Earning Code every exportable dev job has (RH,,OT,,DT,,RDP,,ODT,,DDT); without it Test File and Export reject every CF card (cluster 4B, 2026-11-01).
